deployments_detail.use: AI-powered defect inspection/metrology systems (adaptive AI for critical defect detection, e.g. eSL10)

Agentic AI and AI-assisted workflows developed at KLA's AI and Modeling Center of Excellence (Ann Arbor) for alarm audit, root-cause analysis, procedure creation, and engineering task automation using engineering telemetry, metrology and operational data.

Internal generative AI used by KLA employees to automate and optimize processes 'from writing software code to everyday work tasks,' increasing efficiency and productivity across the global workforce.

aiSIGHT software solution uses machine learning models to automatically detect and classify defects (breaks, bridges, pullbacks, voids) from SEM/eDR images plus design data, and perform large-scale pattern metrology measurements in chip manufacturing. [KLA aiSIGHT]

eSL10 e-beam patterned wafer defect inspection system employs SMARTs deep learning algorithms (built on TensorFlow) that adapt to evolving inspection requirements, isolating the defects most critical to device performance from pattern/process noise. [KLA SMARTs (TensorFlow)]

Voyager 1035 patterned wafer inspection system with DefectWise deep learning technology provides fast, inline separation of defects of interest from pattern noise, improving detection of key defects during production. [KLA DefectWise]
AI-driven metrology systems leverage machine learning to enhance profile modeling and improve measurement accuracy and robustness, identifying nanoscale variations for tighter process control. [KLA]

Klarity Defect automated defect analysis and data management system uses analytics/ML over petabytes of fab data for real-time excursion identification, enabling faster yield learning cycles. [KLA Klarity]

5D Analyzer run-time process control solution provides AI-driven analytics and visualization for advanced-node process optimization and monitoring, feeding results back to the scanner to improve on-product overlay and yield. [KLA 5D Analyzer]
